title: Coefficient-first ordinary etale compact-support projection map
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes admitting a chosen compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-asd-compactifiable]. Use the ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], compact support $Rf_!=Rp_*Dj_!$ for this compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and constant-coefficient derived inverse image $Lf^*$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. For arbitrary $Q\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let $P^r_{f;M,Q}:Rf_!M\otimes_A^L Q\to Rf_!(M\otimes_A^L Lf^*Q)$ be the composite of the counit-defined proper projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map], $Rp_*$ of the inverse canonical open-extension tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and the canonical pullback-composition identification. With $\sigma$ the canonical signed derived symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym], define the coefficient-first compact-support projection map by
$$\Pi_{f;Q,M}:=Rf_!(\sigma_{M,Lf^*Q})\circ P^r_{f;M,Q}\circ\sigma_{Q,Rf_!M}:Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M\longrightarrow Rf_!(Lf^*Q\otimes_A^L M).$$
This defines the map on arbitrary unbounded inputs; no invertibility, boundedness, constructibility or finite-Tor condition is part of the definition.

noncomputable def compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasCompactification f]
    (Q : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    ((-⊗ᴸ-(Y)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj Q).obj ((R(f)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj M) ⟶
      (R(f)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj
        (((-⊗ᴸ-(X)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj (L((f)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj Q)).obj M)
